frequency_question: How often do proposed resolutions of disapproval against major bilateral nuclear or arms agreements successfully pass both houses and survive/override a veto?
membership_rule: Includes all formal congressional review periods for 123 agreements or major arms sales where a joint resolution of disapproval was formally introduced and brought to a vote within the statutory window.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major instances of joint resolutions against Middle East security/nuclear pacts; all failed to achieve a final veto-proof blocking outcome.
known_gaps: Minor non-controversial 123 agreements that never reached a floor vote on a joint resolution of disapproval.
skeleton: Total historical congressional disapproval votes on major Middle East nuclear/arms pacts that failed to successfully block the deal due to presidential vetoes or failure to clear both chambers.
multiplier: 4 historical attempts / 4 resulting in failure to successfully block
validity_reason: Constitutional veto dynamics and statutory thresholds for overriding vetoes remain stable.
